answer: New participants start in a probation lagoon where rewards stay capped until they complete verified work across independent requesters. Sybil resistance here rests on a staked reputation slot vault: each agent bonds tokens to register, and peers score it against a mirror of its on-chain history. Faking identities means locking real capital in every vault, and colluding peers must stake their own bonds, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with each fake identity while honest agents recover stake on exit. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
